trained_on: wound-ROI crops (segmentation output, wound bounding box + 60 % margin)
label_note: Weak labels: a colour proxy computed from the FUSeg masks, NOT a clinical diagnosis. Demonstrator only. See label_rule.
dataset: FUSeg 2021, Foot Ulcer Segmentation Challenge (AZH Wound and Vascular Center); Wang et al., Sci Rep 2020;10:21897

label_rule.derived_from: FUSeg wound masks plus HSV colour thresholds
label_rule.NOT_derived_from: clinical diagnosis, tissue culture, or any clinician adjudication
label_rule.infection_suspected_if: slough fraction > 0.10 OR necrosis fraction > 0.15 of the wound bed
label_rule.slough_defined_as: HSV hue 35-90, S > 0.25, V > 0.35, inside the wound mask
label_rule.erythema_dropped_in_v2: peri-wound redness was in the v1 rule and was removed: healthy granulation is also red, and it made the labels noisy (held-out AUC 0.72)
label_rule.consequence: the infection score is largely a restatement of the wound-bed slough and necrosis percentages, not independent evidence of infection

criteria_guideline: IWGDF/IDSA Guideline on the diagnosis and treatment of diabetes-related foot infection, 2023
transfer: ImageNet: 1.28 million general photographs in 1,000 everyday object classes — dogs, cars, mushrooms. No wounds at all. Only the small head on top was trained on wound images; everything beneath it learned to see on pictures of something else.
